The Five Elders Are at Your Service!!!
The World's Equilibrium Cannot Be Maintained Forever
You're the One Who Should Disappear.
After All These Years I'm Losing My Edge!!!
Luffy Is the Man Who Will Become the King of Pirates!!!
Because the Side of Justice Will Be Whichever Side Wins!!
I Know You're Strong... So I'll Go All Out from the Very Start!!!
Strive to Surpass me, Roronoa Zoro!!!
You Can Only Risk Death While You're Still Alive!!
In Two Years!! At the Sabaody Archipelago!!
Hurry Up and Make Me the Pirate King!
I Do Not Forgive Those Who Laugh at My Family!!!
We're Going to Claim the One Piece!!!
